sloka: सवै न शक्नोमि पितुः प्रतिज्ञा ।मिमामकर्तुम् सकलम् यथावत् ।स ह्यवयोस्तत गुरुर्नियोगे ।देवाश्च भर्ता स गतिस्स धर्मः ॥२-२१-५९॥
transliteration: savai na śaknomi pituḥ pratijñā ।mimāmakartum sakalam yathāvat ।sa hyavayostata gururniyoge ।devāśca bhartā sa gatissa dharmaḥ ॥2-21-59॥

translations.english: It is impossible for me not to execute the promise completely, O my dear, he (Dasaratha) is our preceptor and, therefore, fit to command us. Even for mother Kausalya, he is her husband, her refuge and her dharma.
